Players Committee card image of [[Allegiant General Pryde (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2 image; errata mark “E1”), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Hux is forfeit -3. While with a Resistance character, adds one battle destiny. While Emperor on table, attrition against opponent here is +1 for each First Order character here (limit +3).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8c98fe0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/allegiantgeneralpryde.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/allegiantgeneralpryde.png] as of commit 8c98fe0 “Set 12 Remastered” (20 February 2023).
